reviews.title: Poor Customer Service and Zero Flexibility — Lost a Loyal Customer
reviews.text: I booked this tour at the last minute on my final day, knowing I was already within the 24-hour cancellation window. The original pickup time was 1:15 PM, and my flight departed at 7:15 PM. The schedule was tight but still manageable. However, the pickup was subsequently delayed to 2:00 PM, making it impossible for me to participate in the tour and still catch my flight on time. When I explained the situation and requested a refund or even partial credit, neither Viator nor the tour operator was willing to offer any reasonable solution. I understand that cancellation policies exist, and I accept responsibility for booking within the restricted cancellation period. However, this situation was made worse by the additional pickup delay, which completely changed the feasibility of the tour. Refusing any refund or partial credit under these circumstances demonstrates a disappointing lack of flexibility and customer care. I have used Viator frequently, but this experience has seriously damaged my confidence in the platform. Customer service should be about finding reasonable solutions, not simply hiding behind cancellation policies when circumstances change. I will be exploring alternative booking platforms for my future travels. A loyal customer should be worth more than a rigid policy and a single transaction. Very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Process
reviews.text: Very confusing and I don’t understand if my tour is booked for sure and if paid.

reviews.title: No customer service, dishonest company
reviews.text: They ignore messages and book incorrect dates. Very poor service. Actually, they never answered me so the service isn’t just poor. It’s nonexistent.

reviews.title: We Needed the Tickets, Not a Refund!
reviews.text:
Very Disappointing!

I booked two tickets to the Frida Kahlo Museum back in July, and Viator canceled them just days before our trip. Yes, we got a refund, but we needed the tickets, not the money! We planned this visit months in advance. Very unprofessional and unreliable. I would not recommend Viator!

reviews.title: Trip Ruining App
reviews.text: I have now gone on a handful of viator tours in three countries. I have left every single one completely disappointed. Most recently I had a tour where the guide showed up an hour late and had the flu. Miserable experience, which is unfortunately par for the course on this terrible app. Spend the extra 5 minutes do the research on quality tours and save your trip

reviews.title: Last supper activity

reviews.title: Don’t Rely On Your Reservation!
reviews.text: I have used Viator for years, around the world with generally good experiences, but my most recent experience will have me deleting the app and never using again. My wife and I were on a month-long vacation in Japan and South Korea, and I used the app to book several things along the way. In Busan, I booked a full day private car tour. They canceled it because they had no providers, so I booked a similar one. It was canceled. This happened four times. Why are they advertising a tour that they can’t provide?  Final straw was in Tokyo when I booked a car to Haneda airport. The day before we were to fly, I was contacted by the driver to confirm the pickup time. As it turns out, he was scheduled to pick us up the time our flight was leaving!  My ticket clearly showed my requested pickup time 3 1/2 hours earlier!!  Then Viator tried to tell me that they can’t refund me because I canceled less than 24 hours in advance.  They did refund me, but offered no explanation or apology for the mix up. Anyway, the taxi was cheaper!

reviews.title: Scammy company
reviews.text: Unfortunately Viator cares very little about the customers. I would never touch anything related to this company again as they are laying to customers, providing incorrect misleading information and do nothing to help resolve issues

reviews.title: Absolutely no app support
reviews.text: To get tickets, they now basically make you get the app. But the app has ZERO support. There is no “contact us”. If a booking does not show up in the app - there is ZERO way to find out why. You click the “contact tour operator “ in the email - it takes you to the app, where the tour is not showing up. The help section has zero options for searching for a booking number - which I have. When the app works it’s fine, but when it doesn’t- you’re stuck. Money down the drain.

reviews.title: Great..but endless login loop error so I can’t access it
reviews.text: I like the app but it’s impossible to login in. After you enter an email  it sends a message and when you click the link it wants you to redownload the app. And this keeps looping forever

reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text: I booked a trip through Viator and ended up paying an additional $80 for event tickets because the provider made a mistake. The provider refused to refund the additional money I had to spend because of their error and told me to go through Viator for a refund. Viator then, made it impossible to get costumer service needed for a refund. So, now I’m out $80 because of this organization and the providers it works with. Stay away from Viator if you care about your money and vacation plans.

reviews.title: Refused to publish bad reviews
reviews.text: It forces you to publish a long narrative with every review.  You cannot just rate 5 stars and give a short narrative. If you complain about this practice they will not publish your review.  And, you cannot find the identical tours on The Tour Guy for less money.  So not for me anymore

Once they get your money, they will not refund you!!! I had documentation showing they did not communicate with me where to meet. VIATOR will not stick up for their customers!!!

I have to click the emails individually for vouchers and most of the time it redirects to an error page on the Viator app.

reviews.title: False advertising
reviews.text: The app is easy enough to use and book/cancel through but their pricing is a lie. Looking at adventure pricing from the main screen makes it look like reasonable prices until you click into the actual experience and the price magically doubles or triples. I was able to book an experience for cheaper after using my leftover credit of 42 plus their discount code and it was still cheaper elsewhere!

reviews.title: Viator Disappointed Us
reviews.text: At literally the last moment after walking over a mile to redeem our vouchers for our skip the line tour of the Cisteen Chapel, Viators tour was cancelled. Thus our chance to see a highlight of our trip to Rome ended. Very disappointed in Viator!

reviews.title: Glitch in booking
reviews.text: Had to try many times…logged in and out due to reservation only being held for 6 seconds. Tried on app and on site. Took 25 minutes to finally book when it should have taken 3 minutes.

reviews.title: Scalping and Scamming
reviews.text: This app is for individuals who buy massive amounts of tickets and sell them with false advertising and limited touring ability. Do yourself a favor and check all official sites and/or buy tickets and tours at the site you are visiting. Do not download this app!

reviews.title: Rollover Car Accident on the Way to Booking
reviews.text: Viator SUCKS. On the way to my booking I was in a rollover car accident. We called to cancel about 30 minutes prior to our booking due to the fact that we were on our way to the hospital. After speaking with their support team, they refused to offer any sort of refund or credit. Despite providing pictures and videos of the crash, they offered nothing. Our booking was nearly $600 and we didn’t get even a penny back. We would’ve been more than content with credits to book something else at a later date, and they said they were unable to do that either.

reviews.title: DO NOT BOOK WITH THIS COMPANY — TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
I strongly advise against booking with this company. I paid almost €200 for two Versailles tickets that should have cost less than €60 in total.

When I arrived at Versailles, I could not find the tour guide and nobody answered my WhatsApp messages. Their website clearly said that I could download my ticket, so I did — but at the entrance, the staff told me that the ticket was not valid for entry.

I eventually found a tour guide from a later tour, who told me there was nothing he could do because the actual tickets were supposedly with the guide from my original tour — a guide I had never been able to contact.

So I paid almost €200 and could not use the tickets. What is even worse is that the company provided no proper customer support and refused to refund my money.

This was an extremely frustrating experience. Do not waste your money with this company.

reviews.title: Discrimination?!?!
reviews.text: All booking require minimum 2 people therefore not for solo travelers.

reviews.title: Dishonest dealing
reviews.text: Previous booked tour thru Viatour was cancelled at the last minute after charging my credit card so had to rebook and the price is now half as much.  What the heck??

reviews.title: They charged me on a credit card that I never added to my profile
reviews.text: I dont know how they did it but they charged me on a credit card that I never added to the app for a cancelled reservation. I made a reservation with the credit card on my profile but it was expired so the reservation was canceled by the app automatically (and I can dk nothing about it). But yesterday I just found out that they charged me on another credit card that I never used or added to Viator for that canceled reservation which became “past” now. I dont know how they found the other credit card and charged me for a cancelled reservation by them. This is fraud!

reviews.title: Vacationer
reviews.text: They tried to charge my card before the appointed time

reviews.title: Not easy to use when traveling
reviews.text:
Love the actual bookings, but when I need to login to actually get my tickets or information needed about my booking, it’s a wild maze to get into the app. I have lost a travel guide because the information was not provided via email…and being in a remote location trying to log in to contact the tour operator (because the information was not provided in the actual emailed information) meant I had to find a completely different mode of transport for a party of 14.
Please find a better way to login or gather information to account for times when travelers WiFi and connectivity isn’t great.

reviews.title: My safety was not considered when my tour guide ABANDONED me and my friend in an obscure city.
reviews.text: Warning and beware! Book through ANY OTHER APP!! My friend and I were left for dead in the middle of nowhere due to being 8 minutes late to a meeting point and told to figure it out ourselves. We are tourists in a foreign country and don’t speak the language, we got lost for a few minutes and they drove off with all our stuff still on the bus. Again, we were abandoned in an obscure “city”/town in the middle of nowhere, hours from where we were staying. I have actually had nightmares about this scenario happening. We booked through Viator but Viator operated the tour through a company called “walking tours”. Viator did not care in the slightest and didn’t even give us a refund. Thank you Viator for making my NIGHTMARES come true.

reviews.title: System Glitch
reviews.text:
Twice Bitten 
Booked a day trip to Dover from London 2 times in a week with this app and both times were very disappointing. The first one I was told the system double booked for that day and that my group could not be accommodated. The second one I booked the system didn’t hold the date I entered and right after checkout I noticed the date was for the very next day.  Problem was I would not be in London for another month. I used the chat feature on the app. Long story short they would not solve my issue kept my money and put the blame the tour company. The tour company put the blame on Viator. At the end of the day, No money, no trip, no help, just two days of heartache.

reviews.title: Hidden instructions
reviews.text: Where the map took you was not the location, you had to hunt in the app to find the actual meeting location. So we missed the trip. Do not rely on the map

reviews.title: Unhelpful in event of issue
reviews.text: We had used this app for one trip. When the event went fine no issues it’s an adequate app/service. However we had an issue where we booked something and the event host was unhelpful and we were unable to find the meeting location to attend the event. When we reached out to get a refund for the event we weren’t able to attend… the host stated they gave us the address (which we passed multiple times before the event start time and saw now one) and that there was nothing they would do for us. We then reached out to customer support at Viator and they were unwilling to listen to our side of the story and unwilling to help us find a compromise for the situation. Be wary of all reviews and if you are to book make sure you have no issues as no one will help you to remedy the situation.

reviews.title: Many scam listings on the platform, Viator does nothing to remove them
reviews.text: I almost fell for a scam listing on the platform, and when I brought it to Viator's attention they did not care. It turns out they do nothing to verify or check listings on the platform. I would not use this platform to book any tours, cruises, etc.

reviews.title: Useless middlemen
reviews.text: Very efficient in taking their commission. Very poor in making sure the tour operators provide an accurate description of the tour or provide the tour as planned

reviews.title: Bad customer service
reviews.text: We used this app to book some tours, in the case of one of the tours, they didn’t disclose information about the tour operators additional charges. The tour operator informed us about those one day before the day of the tour, at which point it was too late to cancel or make any other arrangements. The tour operator told us that these charges are not hidden fees and they have been disclosed on their website, they showed us their website and we went over the Viator listing together and saw there was no mention of these fees . They told us that it is Viator that pulls information from their website and therefore it’s viators responsibility to disclose those fees. When we asked for a refund of those extra fees because it was their fault that we had to pay them, Viator refused to take responsibility, and tried to get that refund from the tour operator which they obviously refused as it wasn’t their fault. We had booked with Viator because of the flexible cancellation policy and the belief that they would handle such issues if they happen, but it is better to directly book with the tour operator. Viator offers the same cancellation policies that the tour operator would directly (often these are not as clearly stated on their websites). It’s a good app/website for getting information, but no accountability.

reviews.title: Paid Reviews with Incentives…But Still a Disgraceful Experience
reviews.text:
I’ve given a chance to this app a few times over the last couple of years, and internationally. I’ve used them in Japan, the US and most recently, Italy. The last experience was enough for me to come and leave a review. 

Basically, the app’s concept is to give you the comfort of purchasing something a bit ahead of time with a well built app for 50-100% premium. However, in the end it often turns out that you’re at a disadvantage, compared to purchasing at the entrance of the museum / event / etc. 

Our latest experience turned into a massive wait, where in the end due to the poorly developed process leads to missing the main attraction, I.e Boboli Gardens in Florence. Most of the recent comments are bringing this up as a problem as well. Poorly communicated and organized process by Viator, which in the end leaves you overpaying for an experience that you don’t even get to experience.

Worst part is that the customer service responds (visible on all negative comments on this case) with “sorry you didn’t see the working hours”. 

Disgraceful attitude. I am deleting everything connected to the app and am hopeful that it will respect my GDPR rights by deleting everything they have on file as soon as my account has been deleted as well.

reviews.title: Don’t honor their pricing
reviews.text: I love this company and have used them a bunch…for the first time had to modify a reservation…it’s two days before so figured with the 24 hour policy all would be fine. A tour that was $125 per person when I booked is now suddenly $150 a person….it would be fine if this was something that was clearly stated for modifying a reservation but the fact that canceling one person on the tour made the price for the other three go up even within the window of cancellation is unethical. After this tour, will not book with them again. Leaving this review so others are warned that the 24 hour cancellation/modifying tour reservation is not honored.

reviews.title: Website nightmare
reviews.text:
I don’t even know where to start with Viator, but this has been one of the most frustrating experiences I’ve had with any booking platform.

I went online, created an account, and tried to upload everything I needed through the app—simple, right? Nope. The app wouldn’t work at all. Nothing would upload, and I kept hitting dead ends. So I did what any customer would do—I reached out to customer service.

Big mistake.

The first person I spoke to was completely clueless. No understanding of the issue, no effort to actually help—just reading off what sounded like a script with zero problem-solving skills. At that point, I was already irritated, but I gave it another shot.

I waited 24 hours and called back, hoping for better help. Somehow, it got worse. The second rep had no active listening skills, no urgency, no compassion—nothing. It honestly felt like they didn’t care at all whether my issue got resolved or not.

Here’s the kicker: I ended up fixing the problem myself.

So what exactly is customer service there for?

If you’re thinking about booking through Viator, just be prepared—you’re pretty much on your own if something goes wrong. The platform might look convenient, but when you actually need help, don’t expect much… or anything at all.

reviews.title: Incredibly annoying to use
reviews.text: I get lots of popups and annoying messages to share my booking with people and it’s not obvious where the actual page with the barcode is. Most annoying app ever.

reviews.title: Be aware of tour operators
reviews.text:
I’ve recently booked a tour that “glitched” according to the customer service rep I spoke to on the phone. It said there was 3 spots available and on their back end system it was fully booked, so it auto booked me for the next day. No confirmation, no security measures in place to assure me the change in the date was okay for. 

I finally speak with supervisor Karen (yes that was actually her name) and there were reports from an internal team citing that the tour operator is unresponsive when Viator has reached out. I have the luxury of having 2 devices and while on the phone with Viator, I decided to dial my tour operator and see if they pick up the phone. They were unresponsive. 

This would have been my 3rd excursion on this trip using Viator & it’s shocking that they allow this tour operator to remain on their platform. If they are unresponsive to the platform that hosts their business, what makes you think they would be to the people booking?

So this mixture of glitches and unresponsive hosts has led to this review. I like this app so much that I even said, I understand the glitch, if you would just offer me app credit instead of a refund, I could use it at a different time. They surprisingly refused. I leave this review simply for the people who read every 5 star and 1 star review. Viator will knowingly flag tour operators as unresponsive internally & still allow them to conduct business on their platform without informing the consumer that they are booking with a prob

reviews.text: Booked an activity through Viator and I paid €100 and then when I went to the website of the actual company it was only €60. Extra €40 is ridiculous. Only used this app once and definitely won’t be using again.

reviews.title: Rude Service and Bad App
reviews.text: I tried to make a booking for a date a few weeks in advance but during checkout it defaulted to the next available date instead. I immediately noticed the mistake and used the app to talk to customer service. The first time it crashed half way through my conversation and the next time I was told they couldn’t change it even though I just made the reservation. I asked again in disbelief that they had no way to change a reservation that was just made and the agent responded “as I just told you, we can’t change it.” There are lots of apps just like Viator. I’d recommend using a different one because you’re on your own if you have any issues.

reviews.title: Glitchy and unreliable
reviews.text: Atrocious piece of IT development. Please throw to bin and re do

reviews.title: Failed to provide service and denied full refund!
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing experience with Viator and would not use them again. I booked a car service through Viator to take me to the airport in Aruba. The driver never showed up. I waited over 30 minutes, which is extremely stressful when you’re trying to catch a flight.
I contacted Viator customer service while waiting, and they were unable to get in touch with the car service at all. Essentially, there was no support when it actually mattered.
What made this experience even worse is how the refund was handled. I used Viator rewards along with a small out-of-pocket payment. Since the service was never provided, I requested a full refund. Viator only refunded the cash portion and refused to return my rewards, even though the no-show was completely out of my control and the service was never delivered.
Denying a full refund for a service that never happened is unacceptable. This experience showed a lack of accountability and poor customer service. I would strongly caution others against relying on Viator for time-sensitive transportation, especially airport transfers.

reviews.title: Very Disappointing Experience
reviews.text:
I had a very frustrating and disappointing experience with Viator that I want other travelers to be aware of.
I booked a trip through Viator and accidentally clicked “cancel” on my reservation. Realizing my mistake immediately, I called Viator right away to ask them to add the ticket back or rebook it. Instead of helping, they pushed the responsibility to the local operator and told me to contact them directly.
I contacted the local operator as instructed, but they told me clearly that they could not let me join the tour because they never received any payment from Viator.
When I called Viator again, they simply said they could not do anything because the local operator “does not allow rebooking.” This makes absolutely no sense — the local operator refused only because they received no money. Meanwhile, I paid Viator, received no service, and my money was essentially taken.
Viator kept passing the blame to the local operator and pretending they were innocent, even though the payment and booking were handled entirely by Viator. There was no real effort to fix the issue, no accountability, and no fair solution.
This experience felt extremely unfair and left me feeling powerless as a customer. Please be very careful when booking with Viator. One small mistake can turn into a total loss, with no support and no responsibility taken by the company. Based on my experience, I strongly recommend staying away from viator.

reviews.title: Horrible app
reviews.text:
We booked a tour through Viator and unfortunately had to cancel at the last minute because my husband suddenly became very ill due to a pinched nerve—a truly horrible and painful situation. We provided documentation to show exactly what happened, assuming Viator would understand and offer some level of support or flexibility.
Instead, we received no refund and absolutely no help. The lack of compassion and customer care was extremely disappointing. Things happen when you travel, and we expected a company of this size to handle genuine emergencies more responsibly.
We will think twice before booking with Viator again, and I hope others are aware of how difficult it can be to receive any assistance when unforeseen medical issues arise.
